scope: Checked source-access flow for Boolean short circuit and eager INTEGER bitwise AND/OR

contracts.metadata: Record the category of the checked emitted operator; existing contract payload/module fingerprints detect stale changes
contracts.order: Analyze the left operand once and only reachable right operands; runtime execution and static translation validity checks remain unchanged
contracts.boolean: Decisive left values skip or require right-hand effects; unknown left values make right inputs conditional and intersect write facts with the skipped path
contracts.effects: Optional aliases, routine writes and services never become definite initialization; nonreturning branches retain live continuation facts
contracts.results: Decisive right Boolean constants can determine the result without strengthening optional effects
contracts.integer: Eager bitwise AND/OR, including zero left operands; no implicit Boolean truthiness
contracts.older_contracts: Proven operand facts establish category or an explicit operator-mode gap requests retranslation; no eager-write assumption
contracts.inspection: No target import, execution, eval or callbacks; preserve source/Python/include locations and existing analysis budgets
contracts.format: Existing plan/report/template/run-document schemas retained; no native/controller equivalence or runtime-readiness claim
